item.title: Git and GitHub Foundations Workshop
item.description:
Your GitHub is essentially your second resume. Let's make it good. GitHub Foundations Workshop: Build Your Portfolio with AI covers Git, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot from the ground up, then gets hands-on: build a real GitHub portfolio and README profile you can actually show off, and host it live with GitHub Pages before you leave.
No guest speaker this round; this one's fully student-led by our own officer team, so it moves at a pace built for wherever you're actually starting from.
Verified students on GitHub Education get free access to Copilot's features, so you can follow along the whole time.
Bring your laptop!! Bring a friend!! Free Food and Drinks!!
Hosted by the AWS Student Builder Group at the University of Houston. Wednesday, September 23, 4:00 to 6:00 PM AMG 104 (University of Houston Sugarland) HYBRID (Microsoft Teams)
